note: Independent shape library. Saved SigLIP rankings are read-only reference hints, not labels or geometric reconstruction. Existing system-* renderers are consumed without modifying the active SigLIP implementation. Compatibility is an explicit authored heuristic. Six source-reviewed SAM interpretations extend the catalog. Original IDs and valid parameter values remain supported; zero satellites now expose a plain disc grid in the existing cluster family.

recipes.name: Disc wreath
recipes.logic: Equal circular modules occupy an elliptical orbit at equal angular intervals. Radius is limited to keep neighboring discs separate and inside the field.
recipes.basis: SAM source mask and Codex visual review support this authored vector interpretation. Controls and topology are tested; photographic texture and the original authoring layers are not recovered.

recipes.name: Segmented ring
recipes.logic: Disjoint annular sectors share inner and outer circles. Segment count, angular coverage and band thickness vary independently.
recipes.basis: SAM source mask and Codex visual review support this authored vector interpretation. Controls and topology are tested; photographic texture and the original authoring layers are not recovered.

recipes.name: Polygon contours
recipes.logic: A regular polygon supplies one frame or a family of concentric contours. Side count changes the primitive; equal radial steps and capped stroke width preserve nested gaps.
recipes.basis: SAM source mask and Codex visual review support this authored vector interpretation. Controls and topology are tested; photographic texture and the original authoring layers are not recovered.

recipes.name: Star frame
recipes.logic: Alternating tip and root radii define an even star. A concentric scaled star is subtracted with even-odd fill; zero aperture produces a solid star.
recipes.basis: SAM source mask and Codex visual review support this authored vector interpretation. Controls and topology are tested; photographic texture and the original authoring layers are not recovered.

recipes.name: Notched disc
recipes.logic: A triangular wedge removes part of a disc. The cut can reach its center or stop short; orientation and flattening transform the complete cut silhouette.
recipes.basis: SAM source mask and Codex visual review support this authored vector interpretation. Controls and topology are tested; photographic texture and the original authoring layers are not recovered.

recipes.name: Radial cell mosaic
recipes.logic: Shared concentric band boundaries are partitioned into staggered curved cells. Cell count increases with radius; seeded seam and boundary variations retain the radial organization observed in the source.
recipes.basis: SAM source mask and Codex visual review support this authored vector interpretation. Controls and topology are tested; photographic texture and the original authoring layers are not recovered.
